verdict.rationale: First-party docs state this capability directly for both the consumer app and the API. The app promises 'cited sources for every answer' and up-to-date answers. The Agent API documents answers grounded in real-time web search with inline citations in a single call, and one user reports Perplexity has replaced Google for them. However, hands-on reports say links and references are frequently mismatched to the answer text, and that it cites AI-generated SEO listicles. These are quality concerns, not proof the capability is absent. Missing for 10: independent evidence that citations reliably match the claims they support, and evidence of source-quality filtering against SEO spam.
